quests.title: Kourosh's Sumeru Roses

dialogue.t: Ah, are you here to deliver the Sumeru Roses? I need to see those gorgeous flowers for a change.
So, do you have all ten Sumeru Roses? You can give them to me if you do.

dialogue.sit: Here are the Sumeru Roses you wanted.

dialogue.t: Thank you. They're perfect. It would be nice if my next performance could be as impeccable as they are.

quests.description: Kourosh from the Grand Bazaar needs ten Sumeru Roses.
